#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained
Skip to this scene?
I wonder if this blackboard was being used at some point.
Um――― So, what's up with the costume…?
Bursting. "Bursting" she says?

#C236196003Saber#CDEF's trademark was her loose skirt.
These clothes are, like―――
Still short as ever, I see.

Yes, of course, of course!
I dare say anything looks good on me.
Go on, gaze to your heart's content.

Standing there with his eyebrows furrowed
was #C236196003Archer#CDEF in unexpected clothing.
Wh-what's up with this costume…?

Still… #C236196003Archer#CDEF's trademark is his red coat and black body suit.
These clothes are, like―――
Follow up with "It looks great."

Of course, by that I mean #C236196003Archer#CDEF will get
used to himself. No one around him will ever
get used it.
I follow up with "It looks great."

I-is that so?
It looks good….? Really?

Of course.
I nod up and down silently.
#C236196003Archer#CDEF's expression gradually turns more sour.

W-well, I feel a little better about it since
you say so…

Because then he'll completely and undeniably become a
#C000246204New Archer#CDEF.

………………….
Are you into that? You want the #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF#REND to
turn me into a degenerate?
―――He's cool with it…!
―――What?

That design, that collar; I don't know
who designed this costume, but that person must've
put a chain on that collar.

And yet, why is there only a tag attached?
Shouldn't there be a chain to cover his bare skin?

I understand how #C236196003Archer#CDEF feels.
No matter what he looks like, as long as he's #C236196003Archer#CDEF,
I don't mind.

Thus, I just told #C236196003Archer#CDEF a joke to help him relax,
but it didn't go quite as planned.
―――Say what now?
#C236196003Archer#CDEF throws me a fearless smile.

Kya―I've waited for you, Darling!
Take a deep breath, and with eager anticipation,
please turn around.

I humbly present the magnificent rebirth of
the good-wife fox Servant, #C000246204Punkish Caster#CDEF!

Damn―my head went blank from the shock.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF… What's with this getup…?

What do you think, #RUBS  Master#RUBEDarling#REND?
Is your Servant cute?

Kyaa☆ Thank you very much!
I wasn't so sure at first, but I AM a girl who
looks fabulous in anything…
T-this Servant just let something outrageous slip out!
Could this also be one of #C236196003Caster#CDEF's magic or spells?

Are you asking about this?
……hmm～ A sash, kind of?

A s-sash!? That!?
Then, if she were to unfasten it―――
Um―――it'd slip off?

Haha. How silly you are, Darling.
This is just turtle shell bond―――

Ahem, ahem!
Nevermind.
I truly have no clue as to what this is鷙

Ah―are you more concerned about the color?
See, it was blue up until now.
Does black not suit sweet little me?
Did   you    say    something?

I am my Darling's loyal Servant.
If you so desire, I will wear anything.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF smiles brightly.

…jeez.
Despite the situation we're in, I'm a little relieved.

What innocence.
No matter where she is, she faithfully considers
me as her Master.
This is unmistakably #C236196003Caster#CDEF, a reliable Servant.

Understood. I'll go along with it as well then.
Let's not try too hard though.

Because waiting for me is a man who just blew
all that nostalgia away without a trace.
But―――
Are you really my Servant?

…reeling back my shrinking self,
I set my eyes on the golden Servant again.

In that regard, I can't trust him.
At any rate, there's no basis to.
While frozen by that chill, I say―――
I can't accept this person as my Servant.
I nod in agreement.
……………those were the last words I heard.
I'm at a total loss here.
"I can't trust some #[guy][person]# I don't know!!!"
I-I said it…!

My knees tremble disgracefully,
and with just a few words, my throat goes bone-dry.
At any rate, I gave him what for!

This Servant is a demon.
Once he decides someone is unneeded,
even his own Master, he'll slay them.
…the Servant walks briskly towards the classroom door.
U-um… What's going on?

This… isn't my imagination.
The golden Servant, #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF has a smile on his face,
and he's waiting for me to act.

In our exchange just now, he found
something of interest… maybe.
I said I wanted to know about who #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF is though!
Access to the #C000246204Main Menu#CDEF granted.

Could it really be that she thinks
she "has no more secrets"?

But, no program is perfect. Even if each
individual part is perfect, when two parts
collide, the reaction can breed flaws.

If you can agitate, or even make #C236196003Rani#CDEF excited,
you might be able to get a glimpse of her #C000246204SG#CDEF.

…the hell are you―― Don't talk to me!
Unlike you, I'm busy, see?

Did you know? Conflict only breaks out
between those of equal levels.
Kid bait only baits kids.

Thaaat aside…
Why do you know about Darling's problems?
Did you eavesdrop in so-me-whe-re, hmmm?

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF doesn't know much about real,
interpersonal relationships. Do you, #C236196003Karna#CDEF?

#C236196003Rani#CDEF's final secret… Hmm.
It's difficult to say, since I've never met
#C236196003Rani#CDEF… What's your take, #C236196003Andersen#CDEF?

…are you serious? A harpy like you should
be able to smell a fragrant girl's pretension
all the way from the Labyrinth.

…I don't understand what you mean, but…
have you completely figured out #C236196003Rani#CDEF's secret?

Yes. Thus, I can't give advice. Giving a girl's
secret to outsiders is the height of stupidity.
Like praising flowers while you pluck them.

Or what, #C236196003Kiara#CDEF?
Are you telling me to become an honest writer,
putting the plain truth down with my pen?

…*sigh*. You really are a pain to deal with.
I apologize, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
Please seek help from someone else.

Am I going loony? Why am I going so
far to help those guys? I don't owe them
a dang thing!

Hey, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
Are you and me really friends…?
Of course not.
What're you saying, bro!?

Weird, ain't it?
Why did I get the wrong idea…?

…yo, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
What kind of a face would I make when
I talked to you?

Ah, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF. Listen to this; you know
#C236196003Father Kotomine#CDEF? He says peeps without
Sakurament are no customers of his!

…ah… #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF…
I-I'm alright… alrig…
I'm… alrig…

Huff… huff… huff…
I'm beat…
I can't… really stay conscious.

I…'m hun… gr…
Sakur… ramen…
Old man… mapo tof…

Huh? Am I okay?
I looked like I was about to disappear?
Who? Me? F'real?

As iffffff!
I'm still a club chief, you know?

Well… but, um, you know.
I'm not optimistic about it, so if it does
happen, please ignore it. Yeah.

You're our last hope, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
All I can do is cheer you up and send you off!

I've been reset tons of times,
but being deleted is a first.

Yep, yep!
Now my last worry is gone!
I can send you off with peace of mind!
Do you not know…… what to do next?

Pressing the #C000246204△ button#CDEF……
opens the Main Menu……

In the Main Menu……
the "#C000246204SG#CDEF" entry……
has been added… …did you notice?

You can look…… once again……
at the #C000246204SGs#CDEF you have…… of #C000246204Sentinels#CDEF……
and your Servant……

A-ah…… I don't have an #C000246204SG#CDEF……
because I'm an NPC……

Oh, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF……
So you're okay…… Thank goodness……
From the Main Menu, please select "#C000246204EQUIP#CDEF"……

Phew……
I really…… talked a lot today……

Um! I-it may be a bit late, but……
in the Status entry of the Main Menu……
you can check your Servant's Status.

……I'm sad……
that it was all useless……
from the beginning……
L-let me say it once again……

That said…… under the right conditions,
making Save Data at this stage
might…… be convenient.

A future with your Servant,
or a brand new future……
is up to you to decide……

I heard #C236196003BB#CDEF's school broadcast.
We've been abandoned… no, quarantined maybe.

I know this isn't exactly the best time for it,
but ultimately, it's all I can do.

You humans don't understand just how much
of a monster she's become…

You want to know if I'm still studying?
Yeah, that's right. It amazes even me,
but learning calms me down.

…watch out.
#C236196003BB#CDEF scares me too,
but #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF is just as dangerous.

Be they NPC or AI―same thing.
We were originally created to be
useful to you all.

The writing on the blackboard has been erased.

Stuff like classic literature, reference books,
and past exams are messily arranged here.

I pull a book out.
It's an anthology of an author's works, someone who wrote
poems and children's stories while teaching
agriculture in a poor village.

There's a monthly schedule drawn on the blackboard,
but naturally, nothing is filled in.

Oh? A new survivor? Ah―you're the one,
the #[boy][girl]# #C236196003Sakura#CDEF sheltered in the Infirmary!

Oh, what? When you woke up, the world
completely changed, and you reverted to level 1?

Don't worry, don't worry!
The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF will start bringing everything
under control before you know it!

Not only did the NPCs get swallowed up,
but the Masters too. So there's no reason
to think help won't come, right?

Hmm…
Maybe the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF is playing around with us?

It's always such a stickler for the rules,
but only now―not a siiingle peep.

Well, it'll contact us before we know it!
Nootthhiing to worry about!

#C236196003BB#CDEF this, #C236196003BB#CDEF that. Enough already.
It's just a little runaway AI, right?
#C236196003Sister Caren#CDEF is way scarier!

…ah―but…
Ever since the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF created the #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF,
#C236196003BB#CDEF has been the very first runaway AI.

…this is kinda… well, this might be turn out
to be a big disaster…

Oh, 'sup, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!
Everyone around here's so serious,
but we're strolling on easy street, right!?

Not having scary stories or serious discussions
is where it's at! Let's just chill, it's not
like we don't got the time!

Don't panic, don't panic.
Nothing good ever happens to Masters who panic.

………yeah, that's it.
No point in panicking, anyway. Someone will do
something about all this, for sure.

I don't have any dang Sakurament!
These wads of bills are just
scraps of paper now!?

Agh! How fearsome #C236196003BB#CDEF is! She went straight to
suppressing the circulation of money! She knows
what it takes to rule the people!

Someone like that must never be given power!
Please do your best to get rid of her!

My left side's Spiritron structure collapsed a
bit, but you can see I'm fine on the outside.
Super lucky to be alive at least… yep!

…#C236196003BB#CDEF is a demon… a demon, I tell you…
THIS is being kicked while you're down…
Ahh… This might be the end, for me…

Man, having the Commissary back is a huge help!
I knew #C236196003BB#CDEF was a horrible demon! Buying up all
the item sources in the Commissary!

I won't leave my adorable little #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF
behind and disappear THAT easily!
Nyahahahahaha!

I still have an important administrative role.
If your consciousness-level drops because
I disappear, my incompetence will show.

…heh, heheh…
How embarrassing, my body won't stop shaking…

J-just wait a little longer, okay…?
Once I get my thought-process in order,
I'll be back to my old self, see…

Yoo-hoo, #[hey there][hi]# #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!
Woah! I haven't seen you in a while,
you've grown so big!

At this rate, yeah, you'll be graduating from
this school building tomorrow, yeah!?
This old man is so dang happy!

Now please get a move on and get
back to the Near Side of the Moon!

If not a single Master returns,
they'll talk smack and say,
"this session's administration was useless."

…yep, go on ahead.
Man am I glad that I
just barely made it in time.

I was able to finish this job in the end.
I was one lucky lady.

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, my friend! Help me out!
Let me see your English notes later!
I knocked out during claaass…

Gwah! I lost my Japanese dictionary too!
I was getting comfortable 'cause
my bag was lighter today―this is why!?

Here comes my good friend, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF! Help me
out here! Please let me see your math notes
later. Mine sunk in a sea of drool. Maaaan.

You really do always need to keep a buddy close.
Let's go to karaoke or something after school
some time. Listen to me SING!

Hey, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF. What do you make of that #C236196003BB#CDEF
girl? Y'know, the talk of the town; the transfer
rich girl; the gifted, lovely sheltered lady.

The mass of her chest is terrifying―――
I think it's honestly outrageous.

A girl like that, becoming my girlfriend…
Nah, I can't be aiming that high. First, we'll
have tea together. That'll be the first step!

There's a rumor that #C236196003Ms. Fujimura#CDEF is actually
packing some huge ti… naw, naw, no way. If
it were true, my "radar" would be going off.

It's bothering me, though… Yep, I guess I
gotta do a little research. It sounds like duty
calls for the big-titty-verdict committee.

Hmm, aah… I'm all groggy… I had a bad dream.
Getting chased and almost killed left me with
a real bad taste in my mouth.

Who dost cometh? Be it my friend… my friend…?
What? Wait a sec. Since when were you
and I friends…?

…yeah, sorry for the weird stuff I said.
Ever since I had that dream, I've been off my
rocker. Just forget about it.

…so that really was the case.
I thought we were friends, but I realized
that I can't recall anything about you.

O-oh! Yeah, of course!
Hahahaha… Sorry for asking you a weird
question, #[man][girl]#.

Yo, 'sup, #[bro][sis]#.
Wonder what's gonna happen to us…

Sorry for all the whining.
But you know, you're the only one I can talk
to about this stuff.

Before, like, I asked you to lend me your notes,
yeah? But like, I don't remember taking any
classes. Then it's true… no, never mind.

…for the time being, let's put aside
whether you and I are actually friends or not.

Man, you've been working super hard recently.
Seeing that makes me like… wanna cheer you on.
Don't get beat, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!

Ohh…… you're okay……
I'm glad…… you're safe……

I'm…… the Manager NPC……
tasked with explaining the System……
Thank you…… for having me……

After you're done talking with me……
You can press the #C000246204START button#CDEF……
and hints will come out……

But…… not all events are on there……
There's a lot to do……
so please…… don't overdo it……

There…… you can Save your game……
I recommend Saving frequently……
if you please……

While moving…… you can Jump……
with the #C000246204○ button#CDEF……

There may be no particular use for Jumping……
but whenever you feel like it……
please press it……

I-if you keep staring so much……
It's embarrassing……

If you could make sure to frequently
talk to your Servant in My Room……
I'm sure good things will come of it……

You don't have to…… be here with me……
Even if you talk with me……
I have nothing for you in return……

D-during a conversation……
do you use the #C000246204△ button#CDEF……?

You can Skip through conversations but……
it's possible that……
you might miss some important information……

In that case……
with the #C000246204□ button#CDEF…… the Log appears……
Go ahead and try it out……

By the way, the #C000246204START button#CDEF is different from
the △ button……it will Skip a conversation
until you press it again……how useful……

If you didn't…… use the △ button
to skip over me…… I'd be grateful……

About Mystic Codes……
I think it's better to change equipment
according to the situation……

#C000246204× button#CDEF to equip, #C000246204△ button#CDEF to unequip……
and the #C000246204□ button#CDEF to switch between the
item effect and description……

On the Status screen……
you can use the #C000246204L button & R button#CDEF……
to switch between them……

Please make sure……
to #C000246204Save often with multiple files#CDEF……

If something happens that
can't be taken back… …you can use that
to go back and change it……

My grades? They're the best in my class.
That's how I'm configured.

Huh? The sea? #C236196003Ms. Fujimura#CDEF is going diving?
What the…
She's up to her usual absurdity, I see.

Alright, I got it.
I can't do anything else, so let me take
care of our teacher.

I agreed to help with #C236196003Ms. Fujimura#CDEF. I'll meet
up with her later, so could you go on ahead and
let her know for me?

#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF, you joining the afterschool
study group too? I volunteered. You can get
further there than by studying alone.

…that kind of talk is pointless now.
I'm also an NPC prepared by the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

My default settings are:
"Brightest in his class. Quick-witted,
and also well mannered"…

Though, none of those are worth anything here.
Even if it says I'm capable, what am I
supposed to do in this situation…?

What's up, still need something?
All I can really do is offer a relaxing
study session.

I… can't go against #C236196003BB#CDEF. On the other hand,
I won't get in your way either. I'll do my NPC
thing like I always have been.

"Career counseling is coming up. Need to start
thinking seriously about university. You doing
science, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF? Or liberal arts?"

…that's the gist of what I'm supposed to say
in the 2nd Round of the fights.
They're just empty words, but it's my job.

You say you rescued #C236196003Rani#CDEF out of there?
Congrats. From my perspective, her level
of intellect is outstanding.

#C236196003Rani#CDEF's not an NPC or an AI, but she's artificial
like me. Since I'm the same as her in that
respect, I'm grateful to you.

However… our problem hasn't been resolved yet.
If we don't do something about #C236196003BB#CDEF, we won't be
able to return to our old world…

Hm? You want to know what I'm doing?
I'm studying ahead of the lesson plan,
preparing for college entrance exams.

…thinking back, the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF was great…
The humans weren't so happy with me being so
repetitious, but I had my place there.

Now I'm just a ghost, with no guts
to escape and no goal to fight for.
I really envy #C236196003Sakura#CDEF…

……………sorry.
I hate to ask, but could you leave me
be for a while…?

You still going to head for the Labyrinth?
I commend you for your bravery, but…
please don't make #C236196003BB#CDEF too angry.

Frankly, me simply being up and about like
this is scary… Being absorbed is no joke…

Finishing my role and getting reset would
make for a much more wholesome cyberdeath.

Still… What is #C236196003BB#CDEF trying to accomplish,
appending all that memory to herself?

If self-preservation is the goal,
I would think she's well in the clear at
this point…

Maybe it's because of my base personality… the
soul the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF designed for me. Though I'm
an NPC, so it's more of a shard than a soul.

You made it all this way.
You're fighting of your own volition.
My habit of studying is the same thing.

………hey.
In my own, small way,
I've been thinking about a lot of things…

Yeah, I'm scared of #C236196003BB#CDEF. Her persistence is
absurd. She even took over the foundation,
the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF, to accomplish her goal.

…but, I know she's making a huge mistake.
What a guy like me has to say may not amount
to much, but let me say something.

Please stop #C236196003BB#CDEF, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF. We're manufactured,
but we're part of humanity too. I can't accept
a future where my friends destroy themselves.

See ya. Someday, if you meet "me" again in
the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, please ask me about studying
and stuff. I'm not asking for much.

Wooden desks, grain floor, and retro window frames.
…I'm struck by a strange sense of nostalgia.
This is the year 2030―――I wouldn't be able to
find places like this old-timey school building
has here back on Earth.

Mm, I've been waiting for you, Praetor!
Has #C236196003Sakura#CDEF finished her lecture?
Well then, now it's my turn!

Behind me is a voice I've heard before.
This spirited voice belongs to #C236196003Saber#CDEF.

It's only been several minutes since we reunited
during our fall through that starry sky.

Well, for me that reunion was just a moment ago,
but for all I know, it could have been hours for her.

My memory is still hazy, so I can't recall anything
we did together during the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.

Still, I'm happy that we get to meet again.
I say "good morning" in response, when―――
There, beaming with pride and standing tall, was a white #C236196003Saber#CDEF.

Mm. I'm not sure why, but after I rescued you
and fell towards the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF,
I came back looking like this.

It must be the effect of a system alteration.
#C236196003Sakura#CDEF called these "#C000246204Servant Restraints#CDEF,"
but I don't think they are.

Brand-new clothes are a good thing.
The size is a little too small for me, though.
It's, how should I put it―bursting.

Not much of a surprise.
She's wearing a rider suit that accentuates
the lines of her body.
#[As a man,][Even as a woman,]# I'm not really sure where to look.

…hmph. As a #[man][girl]#, you lack subtlety.
#[A woman][Your friend]# has new clothes on.
Would it not be wise to remark on them?
Apparently, #C236196003Saber#CDEF really wants to hear my opinion.
This outfit looks good on you too.
It looks like a wedding dress.

I-I'm not short, I'm average!
Even if I'm not tall, I'm incredible in
plenty of other ways!

Do you know of the term "Transistor Glamour"?
#RUBS       Small but good quality#RUBEIf not, look it up.#REND There's wisdom in it.

I will not be forgetting this indignity.
Rememb― …no, go ahead and forget. I shall
make you shall rue the day soon enough!

Goodness!
I-it really does, doesn't it!?
So you see it that way as well!?

The "wedding dress" comment made her really happy, huh?
#C236196003Saber#CDEF has a wholly delighted expression.
Like a child, she hops around with a spring in her step.

Several seconds later―perhaps noticing me staring,
#C236196003Saber#CDEF clears her throat with an "ahem,"
and smoothes out her clothes.

A-ah yes, that it is. I'm clearly a bride.
I even have a pure white dress on.

I've always meant to wear this one day,
but it never ended up happening.
Forgive me for being more excited than usual.

…hmhm. But, while I am surprised,
it's the good kind. I never would've expected
you to have such an opinion.
I sigh a little with relief.

Her clothes may be different,
but this girl is unmistakably #C236196003Saber#CDEF.

I may have forgotten many things,
but I get the feeling I can deal with all my fears and worries
as long as she's fighting by my side.

Yes, leave it to me.
I am your sword, and you are my life.

No matter what lies ahead, know that I'm yours.
Use me as you see fit.
